fnol_text: My name is Esther Haddad and I live at 307 Cedar Terrace, Clinton, NC 28346. You can reach me on (555) 714-2353 or esther.haddad@example.com. On 26 September 2024 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Chloe Mensah, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00080. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Haddad on (555) 714-2353 to acknowledge the claim. Esther confirmed the loss date as 26 September 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Fatima Castillo gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Chloe Mensah reports a mild concussion and attended St. Brendan's Hospital. Esther reports a mild concussion.
